slides.title: TAK Page - Instructions
slides.html:
• When TAK page open the first time you will see the quick instructions
  • Page should recognize your device if needed you can manually change the device platform
  • Read trough the instructions

slides.title: TAK Page - General
slides.html: • TAK page is where you get your server connection packages to TAK products like ATAK, WinTAK...

slides.title: TAK Page - Platform
slides.html:
• Page should recognize your device if you want a package for different platform you can change it here and download the correct one
  • Generally each device should have its own Deploy App identity and user shouldn't use same identity on multible devices.
  • This way individual device can be disabled when needed and not every device at the same time

slides.title: TAK Page - ATAK Package
slides.html:
• ATAK has regular .zip package and Auto import package
  • Auto import package works only on ATAK

slides.title: TAK Page - WinTAK Package
slides.html:
• WinTAK and other TAK Products have a product specific .zip package
  • User should use packages made for the product for best experience

slides.title: TAK Page - Instructions
slides.html:
• If you want to see the first time instructions again, click the "info" button
  • If you want to see more instruction, click "Open instructions"

blocks.html: After seeing Deploy App - TAK, continue to TAK Clients
